m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: That scoundrel, Lt. Fletcher, lost my prized Golden Quadrant!
Fletcher knows how much it means to me, and he was careless and foolish. Now it is gone!
However, if he were to find it and return it, I would forgive and forget.
You have returned my prized Quadrant! Thank you, Wizard. Now, to sail out of this wretched swamp!
Let Ponce sally forth with his foolish folly! I'm going home. I just need to find a boat, first...
Is Bligh still chattering on about that blasted Quadrant... you'd think it was a compass or something!
I did not lose it. A Moon Skull Priestess attacked me and took it! What was I, a poor, weak, defenseless Monquistan to do?
Hey, you are tall and strong! Maybe you could you get it back? I don't know which one took it. Fight as many as it takes!
You got it? Great work! I'm sure it was easy to find for one of your stature.
Please take it back to Mr. Bligh. He wants to sail home soon as he can build a boat.
I say, good luck and good riddance. We're all tired of his incessant blathering.
Mr. Bligh is sailing home you say? Well, more fame, fortune, and glory for me then!
Ah, Wizard, you bring good news, no? You have discovered the location of the Water of Life! I shall be famous...
What? You still don't know? Fine. Fame shall wait. While you are here, would you do your dear, old friend a favor?
Two of my crew, Lt. Fletcher and Mr. Bligh, are arguing and it is giving me such a headache!
Go and talk to Mr. Bligh and sort it out for me, yes? I'll reward you with many golden bananas!
Speak to Mr. Bligh and see if you can stop his incessant bickering with Lt. Fletcher.
